Frequently asked questions

Things you
might ask.

What kind of projects do you take on?+

We work across brand identity, websites, digital products, AI systems, 3D, motion and growth. You can start with one focused project or bring us in to connect the whole picture.

Can you work with our existing brand?+

Yes. We can work within your identity, improve a specific experience, or help you decide what needs to change.

Do you design and build websites?+

Both. Design and development sit within the same studio, so the thinking carries through from the first layout to the finished experience.

Do you work with international clients?+

Yes. We are based in Tamil Nadu, India, and work with founders and teams worldwide. We agree on communication and feedback schedules around your time zone.

What will my project cost?+

It depends on the scope, complexity and timeline. Tell us what you need and we will put together a clear proposal before work begins.

How do we get started?+

Send a short introduction, what you want to achieve and any timeline you have in mind. We will discuss the right next step together.

What if the first direction is not right?+

We discuss what is missing and use your feedback to refine the direction. The review process is agreed as part of the project scope.

How involved do we need to be?+

We need your business knowledge, timely feedback and key decisions. We keep the steps clear so you can stay involved without managing every detail.

Do you work with small businesses?+

Yes. We work with ambitious founders and teams, from early ideas to established businesses. We can start with a focused project.

Who is the little blue character?+

Our original studio companion: a curious little reminder that thoughtful technology can have a human side. Created especially for this website.
